description: This file defines the IndentingWriter class, a utility class that extends FilterWriter to provide easy indentation management, newline handling, and spacing capabilities for writing structured textual data.

classes.name: IndentingWriter
classes.description: A specialized writer that manages indentation levels, automatic line breaks, and spacing for more readable output in Java string writing processes.

methods.name: makeIndentingWriter
methods.description: Factory method that wraps an existing Writer with an IndentingWriter if it isn't already one.

methods.name: IndentingWriter
methods.description: Constructs an IndentingWriter with optional space and newline behaviors.

methods.name: newline
methods.description: Inserts a newline into the output, handling indentation if configured.

methods.name: checkAfterNewline
methods.description: Internal method to handle spacing and indentation after a newline.

methods.name: push
methods.description: Increases indentation level by one unit (adding a space).

methods.name: pop
methods.description: Decreases indentation level by removing a space.

methods.name: space
methods.description: Inserts a space into the output, considering the current indentation state.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Overloaded methods to write characters, strings, or character arrays, with special handling for newlines.
